youtube_title: Jesus... Appa Went Diwali Shopping Alone | Matthew 6:21 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

He ordered everything online instead of walking the bazaar with his Appa like they used to, and realised it too late.

He: Jesus... Appa wanted us to shop for Diwali together. Why did I order everything online instead? 🛒
He: He walked the bazaar alone. I was saving time.
Jesus: You bought the lamps. You skipped the reason he wanted the walk.
He: It's just shopping, right? The house looks festive anyway.
Jesus: To him it wasn't shopping. It was the once-a-year walk with his son.

“For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.”
Matthew 6:21 (BSB)

The festival isn't the things. It's who you spend the day with.

💬 What family errand do you keep postponing? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
